m.d: Sleep is the activity or time of resting quietly with eyes shut, usually in bed for many hours at night.
If you sleep, you rest quietly with eyes shut, usually in bed for many hours at night.
m.e: I need to sleep now because I'm tired.

m.d: If you sleep with someone, you have sex with them.
m.e: I haven't slept with my husband in like eight months.

m.d: If you slow someone or something, he, she, or it does not move as quickly as he, she, or it did before; you lower the speed of something.
If you slow, you do not progress as quickly as you did before.
Something is slow if it takes a long time to move. It is not fast.
m.e: A snail is a very slow animal. It moves slowly.

m.d: If something is slow, it does not happen in a short time.
If someone is slow, it takes them a while to understand something.
When something moves slowly or does something slowly, it takes a very long time to do it.
m.e: She was very tired, and walked slowly up the stairs to bed.

m.d: A slip is a small mistake.
A slip is a piece of clothing like a small white skirt, that a woman sometimes wears hidden under her skirt or dress.
A slip is a small piece of paper.
When something slides, or moves a small distance while touching what it's on, we say it slips.
m.e: The hat slipped down until it covered her eyes.

m.d: When someone or something moves without wanting to move, we say it slips.
m.e: My foot slipped when I stepped on some ice, and I almost fell.

m.d: When someone moves quickly and quietly so that other people won't see them move, we say the person slips.
m.e: I slipped into the kitchen to start washing dishes while people were talking.

m.d: A slave is a person who is owned by a master and who works for that master, but receives no—or almost no—money.
To work very hard.
m.e: I've been slaving in the kitchen all day cooking food for Christmas dinner.

m.d: A little; to a very small degree.
m.e: The two pictures look very similar, but they are slightly different.

m.d: When you slap someone, you use something to hit another person, usually with something flat.
m.e: Jane's boyfriend cheated her and she slapped him when she heard about it.

m.d: A woman who loves sex.
A woman who has sex with many men.
A slide is a structure, usually on a playground, that you slide down.
m.e: He made a splash by entering the pool on a water slide.

m.d: A slide is a small photographic image on transparent plastic.
m.e: When Kodak stopped making the slide projector last fall, it was the end of an era.

m.d: A microscope slide is a piece of glass to hold something under a microscope.
m.e: She transferred each flake to a glass slide under a microscope.

m.d: If something slides, it moves smoothly and easily, usually over a surface.
m.e: She put on the brakes and slid sideways fifteen yards before she was stopped by a pine tree.

m.d: If prices, numbers, rates, etc. slide, they go down.
m.e: Oil prices are expected to slide in the near future.

m.d: A slight is when you are not polite to someone.
m.e: Has she forgiven him for his slight?

m.d: If you slight someone, you treat them as if they were not important.
m.e: Ever since that time, he's been slighted by his fellow workers.

m.d: A slight increase, difference, etc. is a small change.
m.e: This year's 5.6% level is a slight increase from last year's 5.4%.

m.d: If someone is slight, they are thin.
m.e: Out stepped a slight, middle-aged woman who smiled kindly.

m.d: A slice is a piece of something that has been sliced.
m.e: I like to have my sandwich with a couple slices of ham it in.

m.d: An act of cutting meat using a small knife.
m.e: I sliced the fish and placed it into another bowl.

m.d: If someone is sleepy, that person feels like they need to sleep; they are tired.
m.e: My son woke me up at four in the morning, and I had to work until eight at night! Now I'm very sleepy.

m.d: If a place is sleepy, it is quiet; there is not a lot happening there.
m.e: After I moved to the big city, I missed my sleepy hometown.

m.d: When someone is slim, they are thin and not fat.
m.e: She is so slim that she looks like a wooden stick.

m.d: The killing of animals is slaughter.
m.e: We kill cows in a slaughter-house.

m.d: The mass killing of men is slaughter.
m.e: The end of a battle is often a slaughter of men.

m.d: To slaughter is to kill many.
m.e: To slaughter is to kill many men or animals.

m.d: If you slam a door or window, you close it hard so that it makes a loud noise.
If you slam something, you hit it hard against a surface.
If you slam somebody, you speak badly about them.
A sleeve is the part of a shirt that covers the arm.
m.e: The sleeve on my shirt is too long for my size.

m.d: If something is sloppy, very wet and contains too much liquid.
m.e: The dog tracked sloppy mud through the kitchen!

m.d: If something is sloppy, it is messy; not neat, elegant, or careful.
m.e: The carpenter did a sloppy job of building the staircase.

m.d: If something is sloppy, it is not precise or loose.
m.e: A sloppy measurement; a sloppy fit!

m.d: To slack is to be lazy and avoid doing work.
m.e: Once he stopped slacking on his homework his grades improved.

m.d: If something is slack, it hangs loose and is not held tight.
m.e: Bring the boats closer together so that the rope between them becomes slack.

m.d: Slavery is the act of using or owning human beings as an object or as slaves, usually using them to do forced labor. It is a crime in most places in the world.
A slit is a narrow cut or opening.
If you slit something, you cut a narrow opening on it.
Tending or liable to cause slipping or sliding.
m.e: A slippery road can be dangerous.

m.d: A sly person is someone who is cunning and deceives others.
A small space usually used to insert coins through.
m.e: My coin was stuck in this small slot.

m.d: Insert something into.
m.e: Slot in any donations into this box.

m.d: A slug is a small slow-moving creature that has a long soft body and no legs
A slug is a slow, lazy person (also known as a sluggard).
A slate is a type of hard rock that splits easily into thin layers.
A slash is a very quick cut of an object, usually with a sharp blade.
The symbol "/", also known as a forward slash in computing.
When you slash an object, you cut it violently with a sharp blade, such as a knife or a sword.
m.e: The samurai slashed the watermelon into two in the blink of an eye.

m.d: To reduce something by a huge amount.
m.e: That shop had to slash its prices for their closing down sales.

m.d: You use slash to mean as well as or and, used to separate two items in a list.
m.e: She's the cook slash waitress.

m.d: A slope is one side of a hill.
m.e: We will have to climb up this slope to get to the top of the hill.

m.d: The slope of a line is how far up it goes divided by how far along it goes.
If something slopes, it goes either up or down.
m.e: The hill slopes down at this point.

m.d: If you slay someone, you kill them in a violent way.
m.e: Our foes must all be slain.

m.d: If you slay someone, you impress or amuse them greatly.
A sleigh is a vehicle that is used to transport people or goods. It is usually pulled by an animal over snow. (contrast "sled", which is smaller)
m.e: Santa travels in a sleigh.

m.d: If you are sleighing, you are riding or driving a sleigh.
Slime is a moist soft, sticky substance.
Slime is mucus-resembling or viscous substance.
A slogan is like a motto, but longer. It is like a catchphrase used in promoting products, candidate or a cause.
m.e: The presidential candidate came up with a very catchy slogan that people can remember clearly.

m.d: A sleeper is a person who sleeps.
A sleeper is a train that carries sleeping cars.
A sleeper is someone or something that looks ordinary but has a secret function that will be used at a much later time.
If something is slimy, it looks or is related to slime.
A slander is the crime of making a false spoken statement damaging to a person's reputation.
If you are slandering someone, you are making false and damaging statements about them.
A sling is a device used to support a hurt part of the body.
If you sling something, you throw it with a circular motion.
A slutty person is someone who resembles or acts like a slut.
A sled is a small, light vehicle with runners that is usually used by children to slide down snow-covered hills.
m.e: The child zoomed down the hill on his sled.

m.d: A sled is a vehicle on runners that is used to transport loads over the snow or ice. (contrast "sleigh", which is larger)
A sled is a snowmobile.
To ride a sled.
A slab is a large and flat piece of a solid material.
If you are slabbing something, you are making it into a slab.
Something, usually a person, that is dishonest, corrupt, shabby, dirty, and/or vulgar.
m.e: That man insulted me. He is so sleazy.

m.d: Low quality.
m.e: That quilt has sleazy lining.

m.d: A slum is a neighbourhood where many poorer people live.
m.e: The slums of Rio de Janeiro don't have proper sewage treatment.

m.d: A slipper is a type of shoe that can be slipped on and off easily.
m.e: Jane loved to come home and put on her warm slippers.

m.d: Sleet is the mixture of rain and snow (hail at times).
If it is sleeting, sleet is coming down from the sky.
Slang is an informal way of speaking that is used mostly within certain social groups.
m.e: I have trouble understanding my kids' slang.

m.d: Slop is a liquid or semi-solid.
Slops are scraps used as food for animals, especially pigs or hogs.
Slops are domestic liquid waste.
If you slop, you accidentally spill or dump liquid, over the edge of a container.
m.e: I slopped water all over my shirt.

m.d: If you slop, you feed pigs.
When something is slender, it means that the object is thin.
m.e: That model is rather slender in shape, which explains why she received many invitations for her photograph to be taken.

m.d: A slump is a sudden fall of something, especially for an extended period.
If a person slumps, they sit or lean heavily.
If the value of something slumps, its price falls suddenly.
m.e: Real estate prices slumped during the recession.

m.d: Sloth is the quality of being lazy or unwilling to do work.
m.e: Sloth is one of the seven deadly sins.

m.d: A sloth is an animal from South America that eats leaves and is usually very slow and inactive.
m.e: The zoo has several sloths from Brazil.

m.d: Slush is half-melted snow or ice that is on the ground.
Slush is flavored shaved ice served as a drink.
Slush is a mixture of grease and other materials that is used as lubrication.
If you slush something, you smear with grease.
A sledgehammer is a large hammer that has a large metal block attached to the handle.
m.e: These sledgehammers will be used for construction work.

m.d: If you sledgehammer something, you hit it with a sledgehammer.
A slur is an offensive and bigoted word used to describe a specific group of people as a way of insulting them.
m.e: Retard is a slur used to describe mentally disabled people.

m.d: If you slur your speech, it means the way you pronounce words is difficult for other people to understand.
When you slurp, you make a lot of noise while you drink.
m.e: People got distracted when I slurped my chocolate milk.
